body:
## AI with Dav3 origin beat: “I am the internet”

Dave’s birthday is **March 15, 1985**, the same calendar date that **Symbolics.com became the first registered .com domain**. Treat this as a striking historical coincidence and a strong narrative/marketing beat, not a causal claim.

### Core framing
**MARCH 15, 1985**
**A HUMAN WAS BORN.**
**SO WAS .COM.**

Dave’s punchline: **“I am the internet.”**

### Creative use
This belongs in the AI with Dav3 mythology, trailers, opening cards, website timeline, documentary/storytelling material, and potentially the Davictionary/origin canon. The comedy comes from treating the coincidence with mythic seriousness while preserving factual accuracy: Dave did not literally cause .com to exist; he shares a birth date with the first .com registration milestone.

### Story implication
The arc can connect the first day of .com to a life that later moves through photography, digital creation, AI, persistent memory, NouGenShards, and human-to-AI command language. It is an unusually clean opening timestamp for the larger technology narrative.

### Suggested line
**Born the day .com was born. Forty-one years later, teaching the internet how to remember me.**

Preserve the factual distinction between coincidence and causation while letting “I am the internet” operate as Dave’s comedic/mythic tagline.
